# Case folding is per character, through Emacs's canonicalize table.
# Positive: these pairs fold together, so each is a block.
* sharp s, capital sharp s
#+begin_aß
x
#+end_aẞ
* final sigma, capital sigma
#+begin_aς
x
#+end_aΣ
* ascii
#+begin_Note
x
#+end_NOTE
# Negative: these do NOT fold in Emacs, so none is a block.
* sharp s vs SS (no multi-char folding)
#+begin_aß
x
#+end_aSS
* long s vs s
#+begin_ſrc
x
#+end_SRC
* dotless i vs i
#+begin_aı
x
#+end_aI
* dotted capital I vs i
#+begin_aİ
x
#+end_ai
* Kelvin sign vs k
#+begin_aK
x
#+end_ak
* ligature fi vs FI
#+begin_ﬁle
x
#+end_FILE
* Kelvin sign in an ASCII literal
CKOCK: [2026-01-01 Thu 10:00]
:DRAWER:
x
:EKD:
